__baseline_prompt__.text: A photograph of a mecha subject on the exposed bed of a vanished inland sea. As a mechanical structure, a giant mechanical walker stands beside a stranded survey buoy, the mechanical subject is visibly present as a coherent physical structure with a broad torso, articulated arms and heavy legs planted on cracked salt. Its chest hatch is open toward the camera, revealing a human pilot seated inside the torso. Use the supplied portrait as the pilot's facial and hair appearance reference. The pilot has a short dark brown bob, wispy separated bangs, brown eyes and softly rounded facial contours. Her face remains individually recognizable through the dusty cockpit opening. She wears a practical faded rust flight suit, its collar loosened at the throat, with a lap harness resting across her hips. Her left forearm rests on the open sill and her right hand holds a small paper route map against her thigh. Both knees remain inside the seat bay, her boots supported by its floor. She looks past the camera toward the buoy, lips slightly parted, catching her breath in the still heat. A white salt tideline high on the walker's shin and the buoy's flaking shell make the lost water level visible. The hatch rim, seated figure and broad machine shoulder form one connected silhouette. Photograph from a nearby maintenance platform level with the cockpit, a three-quarter exterior view wide enough to show the torso and a full near leg reaching the ground. Clear late-afternoon light warms her cheek and the worn steel while the far salt flats dissolve into pale haze; restrained analog color, tactile paint abrasion and quiet expeditionary intimacy.
